home.heading: Personal Finance Tracker
home.placeholder: The app shell is live. Summary, budgets, explore, and dashboards pages land in step 6.x; mortgage tools in step 7.x.

onboarding.title: Onboarding
onboarding.categories_note: Preview of the categories applied to your transactions — you can toggle, edit, or add categories later.

imports.title: Imports
imports.intro: Upload a bank statement (CSV, JSON, or OFX/QFX), map its columns to the app's fields, and preview the result before the import runs.
imports.no_accounts: No accounts yet — add one in the app first.
imports.drop_hint: Drag and drop a statement file here, or
imports.mapping_csv_note: Pick the column for each field; leave a field unmapped if the file has no equivalent.
imports.mapping_json_note: Type the JSON pointer to each field (RFC 6901, e.g. /amount).
imports.array_pointers_note: Comma-separated pointers to the array holding the transactions, tried in order. (root) = the document root; leave blank for root only.
imports.ofx_note: OFX/QFX files map their fields automatically — there is nothing to map. Confirm to store the mapping.
imports.preview_empty: Map at least one field to see a preview.
imports.save_preset_hint: Save this mapping as a reusable preset for this account's statements.

manual_entry.title: Add a transaction manually
manual_entry.intro: Record a transaction that isn't in any statement — it enters the same pipeline as an import.
manual_entry.no_accounts: No accounts yet — add one in the app first.
manual_entry.amount_note: Plain number, up to two decimal places; a minus sign for debits. No currency symbols or thousands separators.
manual_entry.missing: An account, a posted date, and an amount are required.
